entries.name: Blood Trail
entries.description: Deals 25% increased damage to enemies below 50% hull.
sources: Red Wolves: pilot ability.

entries.name: Bodyguard
entries.description: Once per battle, intercepts a hit that would drop an ally below 25% hull, taking it instead.
sources: Aegis Alliance: pilot ability.

entries.name: Data Redundancy
entries.description: Every hit taken while defending grants the whole squad +10% crit chance for the rest of the battle (stacking).
sources: Cygnus Corporation: defend ability.

entries.name: Efficiency Protocol
entries.description: On a successful hit, shaves 1 turn off every squadmate's Chassis Special cooldown.
sources: Cygnus Corporation: pilot ability.

entries.name: Entrenched Formation
entries.description: Defending mitigates more damage when another Republic of Horizon unit is in the squad ("linked formation").
sources: Republic of Horizon: defend ability.

entries.name: Equilibrium
entries.description: When this unit takes a hit for 20%+ of its max hull in one blow, 30% of that damage is spread across squadmates' shields instead.
sources: The Zenith Concord: pilot ability.

entries.name: Field Overdrive
entries.description: No faction doctrine - briefly overclocks weapons for +20% damage on its next attack.
sources: No Faction: chassis ability.

entries.name: Fierce Loyalty
entries.description: The first time this unit would be knocked out, it refuses to eject instead: revives at 15% hull for 2 turns with +20% damage, but can't Defend.
sources: Liberté: pilot ability.

entries.name: Form Up
entries.description: While another Republic of Horizon unit is alive in the squad, the whole squad takes 15% less damage.
sources: Republic of Horizon: pilot ability.

entries.name: Guardian Protocols
entries.description: Defending mitigates 50% of damage and taunts - the enemy squad preferentially targets this unit while it holds the line.
sources: Aegis Alliance: defend ability.

entries.name: Guerrilla Shroud
entries.description: Defending grants +30% evasion. If an attack against this unit misses while defending, it immediately gets a bonus action.
sources: Liberté: defend ability.

entries.name: Harmonic Phase
entries.description: Defending swaps this unit's current shield % with the squad's lowest-shield ally.
sources: The Zenith Concord: defend ability.

entries.name: Independent Operator
entries.description: No faction synergy bonus.
sources: No Faction: pilot ability.

entries.name: Interdiction Field
entries.description: For 2 turns, redirects 30% of damage aimed at the squad's lowest-HP ally into this unit's own shield.
sources: Aegis Alliance: chassis ability.

entries.name: Pack-Link Cannon
entries.description: Guarantees a bonus damage arc to a second enemy, regardless of whether an ally already damaged the target this turn.
sources: Red Wolves: chassis ability.

entries.name: Plasma Aegis
entries.description: Defending recharges 50% of missing shield; if already at full shield, grants the squad's lowest-HP ally a defense buff instead.
sources: Kingdom of Aurora: defend ability.

entries.name: Predator's Pounce
entries.description: Defending only mitigates 20% of damage, but any hit taken while defending primes this unit's next attack to deal double damage.
sources: Red Wolves: defend ability.

entries.name: Prism Lance
entries.description: Its attack pierces through to a second random enemy for 50% splash damage.
sources: Kingdom of Aurora: chassis ability.

entries.name: Resonance Link
entries.description: Tethers two enemies for 3 turns - 40% of damage dealt to one is mirrored onto the other.
sources: The Zenith Concord: chassis ability.

entries.name: Rogue Protocol
entries.description: Drops the pretense of balance entirely, unleashing a devastating strike on a single target.
sources: Equipped pilot: Vaultkeeper [HSP].

entries.name: Scrap Patch
entries.description: The instant this unit's shield is broken, patches 30% of max shield back on the spot.
sources: The Rustfang Clans: pilot ability.

entries.name: Scrap Shielding
entries.description: Defending converts 15% of max hull into an immediate shield restore - trading hull integrity for a barrier.
sources: The Rustfang Clans: defend ability.

entries.name: Shield Siphon
entries.description: On a critical hit, siphons 20% of the target's current shield into this unit's own shield.
sources: Kingdom of Aurora: pilot ability.

entries.name: Shrapnel Burst
entries.description: Its attack also splashes onto 2 random other units in play - which can include allies.
sources: The Rustfang Clans: chassis ability.

entries.name: Standard Brace
entries.description: Standard defensive posture - no faction-specific bonus.
sources: No Faction: defend ability.

entries.name: Suppressive Array
entries.description: Splits its attack across up to two targets at 60% damage each and reduces their accuracy by 15 percentage points (95% to 80%, before evasion) for 2 turns.
sources: Republic of Horizon: chassis ability.

entries.name: System Hack
entries.description: Hacks a target enemy - on its next turn it attacks a random ally on its own side instead of the player squad.
sources: Cygnus Corporation: chassis ability.

entries.name: Thruster Overcharge
entries.description: Instantly grants +25% evasion for 2 turns.
sources: Liberté: chassis ability.

statDescriptions.Defense: Reduces incoming damage by a percentage.
statDescriptions.Evasion: Chance to completely avoid an incoming attack.
statDescriptions.Shield: An energy barrier that absorbs damage before hull integrity. Regenerates between floors.
statDescriptions.Energy Regen: Amount of energy recovered after clearing a floor.
statDescriptions.Shield Regen: Amount of shield recovered after clearing a floor.
statDescriptions.Hull Regen: Amount of health recovered after clearing a floor.

statDescriptions.Base Defense: The warmachine chassis's inherent damage reduction.
